name: Question 15
problem:
Consider the curve defined parametrically as 

$$
x=2\operatorname{ln}⁡t,\,y=t+\frac{1}{t},\,t\in [1,e].
$$

Calculate the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $x$-axis.

Question 15
?

Consider the curve defined parametrically as x=2ln⁡t,y=t+1t,t∈[1,e]. Calculate the surface area generated when this curve is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis.

a
 (e2+2e2)π
b
 (e2+1e2+1)π
c
 (e4+1e2+2)π
d
 (e4−1e2+4)π
e
 (e4−1e2)π
Submit
